title: PELIGROUS WEST (Pelican After Dark)
style: hard electro swing house 128 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, aggressive sub bass drop, brass stabs, swing piano riff, heavy snare build risers, DJ festival drop structure, chant hook vocals, male hype vocal, club mix, wide stereo energy, massive bass impact sections
lyrics:
[INTRO – filtered swing piano + kick pulse]

[CHANT HOOK]
Hey — Pelican run the night
Hey — Western water ignite

[VERSE 1]
Malaga spark at the dockside gate
Pete on the helm, we don’t run late
Brandon tuned the engines tight
Steel and rhythm ready to ignite

Deck lights flick, river glide
Swan River roll with the city beside
Corporate suits turn loose on deck
Ties off now — what you expect

[BUILD]
Hands in the air, bassline rise
Rottnest moon in the sky

[DROP – HEAVY]
Pelican after dark
Strike the spark
West coast rhythm
Tear apart

Livewire bassline hit
Full throttle lit
Indian Ocean pulse
Don’t quit

[VERSE 2]
Bucks night roar, crew on fire
Last run free before the wire
Shoes off, speakers up
Good mates laughing in the cup

BYO cold, eskies packed
BBQ flame out the back
Control the tunes, control the flow
Party how you want it to go

[BUILD 2 – snare roll]
From Carnac splash to Rotto sand
Wave that glass in your hand

[DROP 2 – EXTENDED]
Pelican — run the coast
Livewire — raise the toast
West side — never ghost
Indian Ocean host

Bounce, bounce — Swan River glide
Bounce, bounce — Perth city side
Bounce, bounce — deck alive
Bounce, bounce — feel the tide

[BREAKDOWN – bass pulse only]
Pete steady
Brandon ready
Pelican heavy

[FINAL DROP – MAX]
After dark we own the sea
Private cruise, just you and me
West coast sound, swing and grind
Leave the shoreline far behind

[OUTRO – brass hit + fade]
